status: source-only requirements; adapter source and runtime are not implemented or validated by this artifact

scope.review_actions: targeted source reads and hashes only; no compiler, Cargo, Node, browser, network, native rerun, ACL change, or process ownership change
scope.intended_result: A separate Rust WASM observer using the unchanged frozen SnapshotConsumer, with typed context/lifecycle results and command authorization always Denied.
scope.frozen_files: All existing native, Rust consumer, focused executable, records, baseline shell and browser candidate files remain unchanged.

identity.selection: Initialize once from the explicit pinned trusted host manifest/constructor, never from native frame self-identity. Copy the bounded expected ID into Rust initialization-only scratch and construct owned BuildIdentity. No reset after initialization or terminal state. A deliberately test-only constructor may select the focused ID to consume the 24 actual native records.
identity.mismatch_result: Rejected Snapshot error and no current observed snapshot; authorization remains Denied
identity.observed_v1_plan_identity_source: full-engine-overlay-plan/FULL-INTEGRATION-PLAN.json:6; a historical/planned v1 identity, not the next production identity or runtime evidence
identity.production_expected_build_id_status: The next merged v2 identity is not frozen. Require an explicit expected BuildIdentity from a pinned trusted host manifest/constructor when that build is frozen; do not hardcode the historical v1 or focused compilecheck ID as production.

native_abi.target: wasm32; native pointers and size_t cross this boundary as unsigned 32-bit values
native_abi.pin_zero: No snapshot, unsupported kind, capacity exhaustion or exhausted handle counter; no release is required for zero.
native_abi.handle_identity: Exact nonzero handles are monotonically allocated without reuse; invalid or released data/size return null/zero; release of unknown handle is harmless.
native_abi.lifetime: A pin retains shared_ptr<const string> immutable bytes until that exact handle is released, even when latest publication changes or the active context exits. No context object pointer is exported.
native_abi.native_counter_exhaustion: Counters fail unavailable instead of wrapping.

notification.delivery: The producer freezes the notice and schedules a queueMicrotask callback; no synchronous JS callback reentry during publication. Scheduler/callback/report exceptions are contained.
notification.unsigned_words: Normalize publicationLow/publicationHigh with >>> 0; combine only as BigInt or inside Rust u64, never a JavaScript Number.
notification.other_observers: The planned merged producer also publishes text kind 2 and help kind 3. Dispatch these to their own consumers; do not feed them into this kind-1 consumer.

limits.checked_native_copy: Length must be 1..262144. Address must be nonzero and below the current original heap length, heap length must be <=2^32, and length <= heap_length-address using u64/subtraction-safe arithmetic. Recheck during the actual copy.
limits.response_overflow: Report a typed adapter output error, discard the observed presentation snapshot via invalidate_observation, and remain Denied. Do not truncate JSON or silently drop required fields.
limits.raw_input_limit: Snapshot limits do not define a native user-text limit. Any host raw-input cap must be explicit and reject without changing the input bytes.

frozen_rust_api.safety: The unchanged consumer crate forbids unsafe code. Any required unsafe extern-call boundary belongs only in the new adapter crate and must be small and reviewed.
methods: Notice::from_parts(kind:u32, low:u32, high:u32, availability:u32) -> Result<Notice, NoticeError>
SnapshotConsumer::observe_parts(kind, low, high, availability, &mut T: SnapshotTransport) -> ObservationOutcome<T::Error>
transport_trait: copy_owned(&mut self, address:u32, length:u32) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Self::Error>
snapshot_release(&mut self, handle:u32) -> (); must not panic
frozen_rust_api.ownership: Transport addresses refer to the original module's heap, never the Rust adapter's heap. copy_owned returns Rust-owned Vec bytes; frozen PinGuard releases before parse_snapshot is called. Parsed strings/actions/bindings are owned. snapshot() borrows only from the consumer until its next mutation; never export that borrow as a retained JS/native pointer.
frozen_rust_api.authorization: ContextSnapshot::command_authorization and SnapshotConsumer::command_authorization always return CommandAuthorization::Denied(DenialReason::UntrackedNativeReaders). The enum has no Allowed variant.
frozen_rust_api.parser_contract: Strict UTF-8; size/field/vector limits; deny unknown JSON fields; schema/interface/source/build/phase/binding-authority checks; canonical decimal u64 counters; nonzero publication/epoch with epoch<=publication; depth and parent constraints; RawUtf8 iff STRING_INPUT; contiguous action indices; valid binding origin and strictly ordered unique modifiers. No commands are constructed.

lifecycle.event: Unsupported notice kind, availability, or illegal zero publication
lifecycle.result: Rejected(Notice); current snapshot cleared; last publication and terminal flag are preserved.
TerminalUnavailable; snapshot cleared; terminal flag stays true for the lifetime of this consumer.
Every subsequent valid notice returns TerminalUnavailable with no transport. Invalid notices still reject before observe, while terminal remains true.
Rejected(ConflictingNotice); snapshot cleared; last notice unchanged.
Last notice advances; snapshot cleared; Unavailable(availability); no native pin. Nonzero Unsupported is not terminal.
Last notice advances and prior snapshot clears; checked owned copy/release, then strict parse; matching publication yields owned Ready snapshot.
Rejected; current snapshot stays absent; no retry at the same publication.
Only snapshot clears; publication ordering and terminal state stay unchanged. Repeated initialization must not reset these protections.
A new publication may restore an older context_epoch with current original bindings. Order by publication, not by context epoch.

proposed_minimal_adapter.build_kind: Separate cdylib WASM module exporting its own memory; do not replace or weaken the existing import-free rust-browser-bridge module.
proposed_minimal_adapter.optional_serialization_dependencies: If a response DTO uses Serialize, pin serde/serde_json to the same exact versions. No wasm-bindgen, network, clock, RNG, engine command or DOM dependency is needed.
proposed_minimal_adapter.expected_identity: The host loader accepts an explicit pinned trusted manifest/constructor expected build ID. Initialization copies its strict UTF-8 bytes into an adapter-owned scratch buffer (1..16384 bytes), then seals one owned BuildIdentity. The next v2 production ID is unfrozen; no native-packet identity, historical v1 constant or focused test identity is an implicit fallback.

exports.name: cdda_input_adapter_identity_staging_ptr
exports.purpose: Before initialization only, expose an owned 16384-byte Rust scratch buffer so the host can copy the trusted expected ID. Return zero after initialization; no retained pointer or reinitialization.

exports.name: cdda_input_adapter_init
exports.purpose: Read only the bounded initialized scratch prefix, validate strict UTF-8 and BuildIdentity::new, then seal one consumer. Repeated init returns already-initialized status without resetting ordering, identity or terminal state.

exports.name: cdda_input_adapter_observe
exports.purpose: Call frozen observe_parts with the real host-import transport; produce a typed owned response.

exports.name: cdda_input_adapter_invalidate
exports.purpose: Call invalidate_observation and regenerate an absent-snapshot response, retaining ordering/terminal state.

exports.name: cdda_input_adapter_response_ptr
exports.purpose: Pointer into adapter memory only; host synchronously copies before any mutating export or await.

host_imports.name: snapshot_pin
host_imports.native: _cdda_browser_snapshot_pin; record each nonzero handle in the active session ownership set

host_imports.name: heap_length
host_imports.native: Current original HEAPU8 byteLength; Wasm i64 host result is a BigInt

host_imports.name: copy_to_rust
host_imports.native: Recheck both current memories; copy an owned original heap slice into the already allocated Rust Vec; return explicit success/error status

host_imports.name: snapshot_release
host_imports.native: _cdda_browser_snapshot_release; remove released handle from session ownership set; must not throw or panic

proposed_minimal_adapter.transport_implementation: Implement the exact frozen SnapshotTransport trait. Allocate a Vec of the checked bounded length inside copy_owned, pass only its destination address to copy_to_rust, return that owned Vec on success, and propagate host failures as transport errors. Native addresses are never dereferenced by Rust. No staged frame, synthetic native handle or modeled transport is used in production.
proposed_minimal_adapter.state: One adapter instance owns one once-initialized BuildIdentity/SnapshotConsumer plus a separate bounded response buffer. Avoid reentrant mutable access; fail closed on attempted reentry. Imports contain exceptions and use explicit error status conventions; never throw through Rust/Wasm. An instance change requires fresh trusted host initialization rather than resetting the old terminal consumer.

fields: typed observation outcome and optional error
last_publication_sequence as decimal string or two u32 words
response.context_projection: Use public model getters. Preserve exact category, epochs, depth, timeout, modes and flags; action IDs/origins and binding descriptors may be exposed as bounded observation data where presentation requires them. Never infer or dispatch a command from them.
response.integers: All u64 values use decimal strings or low/high words in JS; no conversion to Number.
response.invalid_utf8_or_output_failure: Return a typed absent-snapshot error and preserve Denied; no lossy decoding or truncated JSON.
response.lifetime: response_ptr/len refer only to the current Rust-owned buffer and expire at the next mutating export. JS must re-resolve adapter memory, validate the range and take its own copy synchronously; no retained view, await, or exported borrowed ContextSnapshot.

proposed_minimal_adapter.initialization_lifetime: Host validates trusted manifest identity and length, requests the initialization-only scratch pointer, re-resolves actual Rust memory and checks destination bounds, writes the exact UTF-8 bytes and calls init(length) synchronously. Rust parses its own bounded scratch slice without accepting an arbitrary caller pointer. Dispose/invalidate the scratch pointer after init; no production reset/reconfigure export exists.

synchronous_transport_sequence: Load and verify the separate adapter, seal the expected BuildIdentity from an explicit pinned trusted host manifest/constructor via bounded initialization-only scratch, configure actual native snapshot exports, and install the kind-1 dispatcher before engine main can publish tracked contexts.
Receive the frozen native notice in its microtask. Normalize unsigned words, route kinds 2/3 elsewhere, and open a synchronous host transport session.
Invoke cdda_input_adapter_observe. Frozen consumer validates notice/order; only fresh Ready reaches snapshot_pin(1).
For a successful real native pin, frozen PinGuard calls data/size, validates length and native address/heap range, then calls copy_owned.

copy_owned allocates a bounded Rust Vec. Host copy_to_rust re-resolves original HEAPU8 and adapter memory, rechecks unsigned source and destination ranges, takes an owned Uint8Array.slice from the original heap, then writes exactly those bytes into the Vec. No engine input/draw/RNG, await, native context pointer, or retained native heap view.
Frozen PinGuard releases every successful pin on normal copy or any error, before parse_snapshot. Consumer then parses owned bytes and enforces notice/frame publication equality.

Host observe wrapper uses try/finally to release any still-owned real native handles if Wasm traps or aborts before Rust Drop executes. Scope ownership to this wrapper/module, never release another observer's handle. Normal release removes the handle, so finally does not release twice.

Copy the bounded typed response out of the current Rust memory before any mutation/await. Render observation data with textContent and report bounded diagnostics. On failure, invalidate/clear observed UI; do not interrupt native event handling.

four_layer_placement.name: Original engine authority
four_layer_placement.role: Original C++ action tables/context wait and immutable read-only publication; native SDL loop continues to own execution.

four_layer_placement.name: Host platform and memory boundary
four_layer_placement.role: Real native exports, notice dispatch, unsigned words, current-heap bounded copy, owned-handle finally cleanup. No action interpretation or raw-text rewriting.

four_layer_placement.name: Typed Rust observation contract
four_layer_placement.role: Unchanged consumer lifecycle/parser/model, always-Denied authorization, narrow WASM exports and bounded typed response.

four_layer_placement.name: Browser presentation and separate raw input
four_layer_placement.role: A new separate integrated shell can display context observations. Preserve physical input/text handoff and helper behavior within its already authorized path; snapshots never authorize native commands.

raw_utf8.separation: Raw user text is a separate owned host buffer and never enters SnapshotConsumer or a binding/action resolver. Snapshot STRING_INPUT/RawUtf8 is observed policy metadata, not the text payload.
raw_utf8.identity_pass_through: Copy valid UTF-8 bytes without trim, case fold, normalization, translation, decode/re-encode changes or binding.text substitution. Preserve CJK, combining characters and supplementary scalars byte-for-byte. Reject malformed UTF-8 rather than replace characters. If a DOM UTF-16 string is encoded, reject invalid surrogate input instead of silently relying on TextEncoder replacement.
raw_utf8.existing_source: baseline-preview/shell/baseline-shell.js:261 submits for (const key of input.value) sendKey(key), then clears the field. Helper buttons alone resolveHelperKey(..., 'menu') at :256. sendKey is :238; form keyboard capture is :231.
raw_utf8.existing_handoff: sendKey keeps the original event.key, dispatches synthetic keydown/up, and dispatches keypress only for key.length===1. Its legacy code/keyCode/which use UTF-16 charCodeAt(0). Supplementary scalars have length 2 and therefore receive no keypress in this helper.
raw_utf8.scope_gap: An unchanged host UTF-8 buffer or scripted native raw input proves identity at its own boundary only. It does not prove actual native SDL_TEXTINPUT/IME delivery, supplementary characters, composing input, committed text, focus timing or command execution. Resolve this in a separately approved real-native/browser input path; do not claim the snapshot adapter fills that gap.
raw_utf8.authorization: Raw input pass-through does not upgrade CommandAuthorization. Snapshot Ready, RawUtf8 and registered action/binding data all remain Denied(UntrackedNativeReaders).

native_proof.claim: Selected exact original header/member definitions linked and executed with harness-initialized action tables and scripted hardware/UI leaves; genuine captured native snapshot bytes. Full original class/UI translation units and browser raw events were not executed.

full_engine_prerequisites_and_blockers: Use the separate Rust owner's accepted five-test compact proof and frozen pins; adapter changes must not edit those files. This review records the parent's reported acceptance and does not rerun it.
Root-reviewed owned compile/link/browser plan with frozen SDK, exact sources/artifacts, resource limits, job ownership/closure and no implicit retry. This artifact authorizes no execution.

Freeze the next v2 trusted manifest identity, then complete the merged observer build with actual pin/data/size/release exports and independently reviewed common semantic layout across affected C++ translation units. Historical v1 and focused identities are not production fallback values.
Stage the merged native assets and separate adapter in a fresh integrated candidate/shell; verify asset hashes and licenses. Do not mutate the accepted observer-unaware candidate.
Demonstrate actual native notice delivery during asynchronous browser input waits and proper unavailable/parent restoration lifecycle, including kinds 1/2/3 routing.
Untracked original input readers keep command authorization denied. This adapter does not provide or assume a complete native command reader registry.
